lines.en: Oh, come on. Do you see this? Disgusting.
To whoever made the microwave mess, the microwave is a shared kitchen appliance.
By not cleaning it up, you are basically telling whoever follows that their time is less valuable,
as they will have to scrub out your disgusting splatter.
Sincerely, Disappointed.
Well, that is just obnoxious.
No kidding.
Yeah.
Wait, what? The mess or the note?
The note. I'm so holier than thou.
Hmm. I liked it.
Don't you think the person who left the mess is the obnoxious one?
No.
The note is way more obnoxious than the mess.
Sincerely, Disappointed. Get off your high horse, Richie.
Just because someone likes things clean doesn't mean they're rich.
Eh, they're rich.
Yeah, I wrote the note.
I'm not ashamed of it.
I'm not proud of it.
It is what it is.
Everyone keeps asking me if I wrote the note on the microwave.
It was rude and condescending and a little snotty.
I wish I had written it.
Hey, anonymous coward who left the note, be a man, spend less time writing notes and more time cleaning up the microwave.
The nerve.
Hey, whoever was bashing the first note, grow up.
The microwave is filthy and no one here is a maid.
See?
Someone around here is sane.
You're all a bunch of idiots and privileged asswipes who weren't raised right.
If I find you, I'm going to knock your teeth out.
Yikes.
It's a little over the top.
Their heart's in the right place.
Hey, Pam.
Pam, I just wanted to let you know I'm totally on your side with the whole microwave situation.
Thank you.
I was just back there to make some cup of soup.
The thing is still a huge mess.
I know.
Can you believe it?
Yeah.
It's crazy.
But I guess the thing is, at some point, notes or no notes, someone's going to have to just get in there and clean it up.
I guess that's why we have a temp, huh?
Oh, no.
Trust me.
I would just make it worse.
How would wiping it with a paper towel make it worse?
I would find a way.
You've seen things clean before, though, right?
Pam, I'm hopeless to that stuff.
I, I, uh...
Pervert.
Angela, I didn't do that.
So is this what they taught you at your fancy art school?
Why would I draw a penis on my own note?
Why do you wear bright colors?
For attention, Pam.
Everyone, I have an announcement to make.
I'm the person who put the first note on the microwave.
But I did it because it needed to be said.
Where did you hide behind anonymity?
Because I was scared.
But if that's my only crime, is it a worse crime than leaving a filthy microwave?
Amen.
Don't.
This is for real.
Just clean it up yourself if it bothers you so much.
It's not my mess.
It would have taken less time to clean it up than to write all those notes.
That's not the point.
Listen, New York.
That might fly.
Why?
Because I went to New York for three months?
That and the black sweater of Manhattan.
Okay, yes.
I went to New York, everybody.
I'm not going to apologize for it.
I experienced more there in one week than I experienced here in three months.
I love New York.
You know, I especially love the people there cleaned up after themselves.
Well, I work too hard all day to be the maid here, too.
I got a mess to clean up at home, plus I'm a part-time maid.
And what about the penises?
I thought those were funny.
I didn't do them, Phyllis.
It's the anonymity that I find so cowardly.
Really?
Can you just get over that part?
Why should I?
You couldn't get over the messy microwave.
I don't know.
